mostWorthwhile.text: Moth's shortest route using stairs, followed by the residents' survey, made the difference between optimizing distance and meeting an actual access need concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the matching traction mat was sensible but predictable, with little decision-making involved.

surprise.text: The final walk recorded troublesome corners rather than preserving the neat route line; it used an empty crate rather than demonstrating a loaded run.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though several later actions were the only offered combination, so their compatibility was given rather than discovered.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see whether the neighborhood can correct the directory; the practical repairs and the mismatch between Moth's route and residents' needs held my interest, despite the constrained choices.
